text: Started: shortcuts panel behind ?. First job is deriving the real shortcut list from source, not from the card.

Shortcuts panel works in a real browser. 35 rows derived from the handlers in braindump.js, not from the card. New suite tests/board/shortcuts-panel.test.mjs: fails on the current file at phase A, all 6 phases pass on the patched build. Phase E drives five advertised gestures for real (P pen, alt-drag copy, shift axis lock, wheel zoom, Ctrl+click pin) and asserts the board does what the row says.

Done. patch.json has 3 hunks on braindump.js, every anchor re-verified unique against the file on disk. 8 neighbouring suites re-run against a mirror carrying the patched file, all green, including board-shift-snap-runtime and toolbar-panel-viewport-fit. Surprises are in notes.md: there is no keyboard shortcut for the canvas tool, right-drag pans, and shift+click adds to a selection. My 4194 server is stopped, board-save-reload-e2e owns that port.
